0.1.0.description:
# Equilinox AP v0.1.0 Beta Release! ### View the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient#setup-instructions) on the Github repository. Currently, only Windows is supported. ## Current Features:
  • Evolution Checks
  • Task Checks
  • Species Size Checks
  • Species Unlock Items
  • Two Goal options: Evolve a Camel, or Complete Every Task
  • DP options in YAML
  • Connection info saved in the save file
## Known Issues:
  • On pages with multiple text input fields, you click the icon that looks like a pen in a square to edit the field. You then need to click it again to stop editing that field before editing the next text field. This happens because I am using the game's built-in text field object, which does not automatically deselect when you select a different one (because in the vanilla game, there are never 2+ text fields in the same menu). This is something I'd like to fix because it is kind of annoying, but it doesn't break anything. Since it will likely be somewhat involved to actually fix, it'll be left as-is for now.
  • Certain characters in a world (save file) name stop the game from loading the world properly. I know of "-" and "." breaking things, so if you put these in the "World Name" field, it just removes them before creating the world. If you create a world that later will not show up in the "load world" menu, send me the world save file and I'll take a look at it (see the readme.md for instructions on how to do this, in the Reporting Issues section).
  • There are currently no Archipelago logos/icons in game. I plan to add them in a future update, replacing the rainbow circle currently used.
  • Deathlink is not currently supported. If you have ideas for what deathlink would look like in this game, feel free to share in the Equilinox thread in the AP discord server.
### For more information, see the [README](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient/blob/master/README.md).

0.1.2.description:
## Changelog

### Game mod
- Censor server password in the popup console window and the APEqLog.log file
- Save slot data in world save file
    - This helps in the scenario where you load an existing world but can't connect to the server. Before, the game couldn't remember slot data and would just use default settings until a connection could be established.
- Reformat how the mod version is saved in the game save files, and save the mod version on which the multiworld was generated 
    - The latter is not actually used right now, but will be the next time a major feature is added to try and maintain backwards compatibility.


### .apworld
- Fix error where "Evolve Camel" goal completion was in logic immediately
- Scale logically required DP amounts for evolution and size checks by the species' tier


## Updating the Mod

View the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient#setup-instructions) on the Github repository.

This update is compatible with worlds generated on any v0.1.x.

0.2.0.description:
## Changelog

### General Changes/Additions
- Replaced "Evolve Camel" goal with "Evolve Species" goal: 
  - Choose a set of species and a count `n` (defaults to all selected species), where you need to evolve `n` of the species in the set to send the goal
- Add "Progressive DP/Min Bonus" item:
  - Yaml option to add 0 - 40 (default 10) of these to the item pool. Having received `n` of these items, you will have a constant bonus of `+15(n^2+n) dp/min`
- Notable logic changes:
  - Logically require dp generation (either via the new "Progressive DP/Min Bonus" item or via animals) for most purchases and evolutions
  - More tasks and evolutions logically require species satisfaction
    - (While I tested many of these changes, please report any checks that appear in logic too early in case I missed some)
- Add item groups for unlock permits: `Tier 1 Plant Permits`, `Tier 1 Animal Permits`, `Stone Permits`, and `Large Rock Permits`. 
- Fix .apworld manifest?


### Minor Client Changes
- Display connection status, received dp items, and goal progress in the AP Toolbar menu
- Make fast-forward (the double arrow button on the bottom bar) a toggle instead of a press-and-hold
- Send in-game notification when trying to connect
- Mouseover of locked tier 1 shop items now displays "Find in the multiworld: ______ Permit" instead of "Unlocked by task: _______"


## Updating the Mod

View the [Setup Guide](https://github.com/AAces17/EquilinoxAPClient#setup-instructions) on the Github repository.

This updated client should be compatible with worlds generated on any v0.1.x. However, updating the client mid-run is not necessary unless you really want the new QOL features.
